completeProcedures.skilled: Choose any combination totaling three distinct eligible skill or tool proficiencies not already possessed. NEW: resolve fixed existing class/background grants first, then these actual choices in order. Any-tool scope includes profiled non-artisan tools such as Fishing tackle, Herbalism kit or thieves’ tools; it does not grant every tool in a kit family. Each primary-trade credential can initialize only its mapped trade at level1/zeroXP, while already higher lawful training remains. No Expertise, ability score, extra PB, formula or physical kit is granted. Choice exhaustion and later duplicates follow the shared rule; a later class/background gain does not freely retarget this historical selection. The feat is not repeatable under this proposal because the source does not say so.
completeProcedures.jack_of_all_trades: At acquisition choose two distinct actual skills in which you lack proficiency. On an actual check using one of those skills, add floor(currentPB/2) while you remain unproficient. This is the proficiency contribution, not a bonus added to a different full/half/expert proficiency contribution on the same check; use one actually applicable strongest contribution. It does not count as trained proficiency, satisfy a proficient prerequisite, initialize a trade, modify tools, attacks, saves or an unskilled ability check. NEW: if you later gain proficiency in a chosen skill, use that full contribution and retain the original selection as inactive; there is no free retargeting or banked choice. If that separate proficiency is actually lost, this feat’s same half-PB contribution can resume. No new skill slots or free respec are created by its legacy wording.
completeProcedures.cultural_expert: At acquisition choose History, Religion, or one specifically documented culture-specific Lore credential. If you are not proficient in the selected credential, gain its proficiency. If you already are, use twice PB for that credential's checks concerning cultures, customs and historical context; other checks in the selected skill retain normal PB. NEW: snapshot which branch applies on acquisition. Later gaining proficiency from another source does not retroactively convert the initial proficiency grant into Expertise. If a chosen culture has no separate recorded Lore credential, record a bounded History specialization for that named existing culture. It gives proficiency only for that subject, or twice PB there if History or that same subject is already proficient; it never creates general proficiency in a twenty-first skill. Double PB replaces rather than adds to normal PB and does not stack with other Expertise. Preserve actual access to knowledge and existing canon. No cosmological fact or cultural history is authored by choosing the feat.
completeProcedures.linguist: Choose three distinct eligible language competencies not already fully known. Apply the reviewed permanent-language grant convention to their attested speaking/comprehension/reading/writing modes; a written-only tradition has only its actual modes. The Director’s genuine available choice/contact list, named-source restrictions and duplicate/exhaustion procedure control. This explicit acquisition grant needs no ordinary course or retroactive tuition, but invents no anatomy, teacher, protected curriculum, hidden-language authority, Cipher skill or Language Insight. NEW: the description’s study of codes is narrative only; the printed effect supplies no extra cipher DC, speed or automatic decoding. Existing known language does not make an unknown script’s contents true, complete or deciphered.
completeProcedures.polyglot: Choose three distinct eligible languages using the same reviewed acquisition, availability, duplicate and attested-mode rules as Linguist. The current effect preserves the described spoken/read/written grant; no ordinary course is required for this explicit grant. Gain advantage only on an actually required check to identify an unfamiliar dialect or script genuinely related to one of these three recorded choices. Shared script can support a script-identification relationship without supplying semantic comprehension. Use the language guide’s ordinary one-minute recognition procedure and relevant INT/History DC10/15/20 as applicable. The advantage does not apply automatically to every translation, cipher, ancient script, communication or Language Insight check. An obvious known identity needs no roll; nondiagnostic evidence cannot become diagnostic by rolling twice. NEW: record the three choices as the specific family anchors; other languages known from unrelated sources do not expand this feat’s bonus.
